findings.invariant: Stored valid_from/valid_to/asserted_at/retracted_at/last_confirmed_at/created_at are not serialized on the only agent-facing claim line.
findings.detail: Historical closed interval Orchard Library 2020-01-01/2021-06-01 and current open Lighthouse Lab 2022-01-01 both print as status=live working knowledge with no timestamps. A reader cannot tell past from current.

findings.invariant: Conflict detection uses validity overlap internally, but the served line has no interval and lists every live peer on the key.
findings.detail: live=3 included the 2020-2021 Orchard Library row that does not overlap the 2022-open and 2026-open peers.

findings.evidence: static TOOLS list; RFC 0002 deferred as_of_valid/as_of_transaction
findings.invariant: There is no query_claims tool and no as-of read surface.
findings.detail: Claims reach agents only as context_packet markdown plus propose/correct receipts. ClaimV2 temporal_basis is validator-only (claim-v2.ts), not stored.

findings.invariant: Grant since/until filters claims by valid_from. Packet since/until does not.
findings.detail: Windowed agent (2026-02-28T10:30Z..13:30Z) served only Harbor Desk (valid_from 2026-02-28T11:00:00Z) and omitted the gap that requires unread historical rows.
